tema: Faça a narração em inglês o pescador da meia-noite
legenda: O rio esconde mistérios que ninguém deveria descobrir. Você teria coragem de encarar essa entidade na escuridão? 🎣 Deixe sua resposta nos comentários! #terror #suspense #historiaassustadora #pescadordameianoite
falas: Every midnight, a shadowy fisherman pulls glowing red nets from the foggy river, but tonight he trapped me.
I only wanted to fix my boat, but the water suddenly turned black as pitch around my oars.
Then a silent tall figure appeared in a torn black cloak, standing right on top of the water.
He slowly pointed his pale hand at my chest, and my own heartbeat started echoing across the dark lake.
Deep beneath the surface, hundreds of glowing blue eyes opened, watching my every movement in total silence.
The strange entity whispered my full name, offering his glowing fishing rod in exchange for my deepest secret.
I escaped to the shore, but my reflection stays on the water. Would you answer the midnight fisherman?
